name: Twilight Whisker
summary: In Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil gathers Twilight Whisker for his brew. Twilight runners carry the whiskers in the northern heights of the Stonetalon Mountains.

sections.title: A Witch Doctor's Reagent
sections.body: Twilight runners prowl the high crags near Stonetalon Peak. Hunters prize their pelts, while Witch Doctor Jin'Zil of Malaka'jin wants their stiff whiskers for a darker purpose. He seeks vengeance on night elves captured after defending these woodlands. To mock and poison his captives, Jin'Zil gathers resinous sap, countless eyes, fey dragon scales, and Twilight Whisker for a lethal draught he calls forest magic.

faq.answer: Twilight runners on the slopes around Stonetalon Peak in the northern Stonetalon Mountains carry Twilight Whisker.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Jin'Zil want them?
aliases: why does jinzil want twilight whiskers
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil combines Twilight Whisker with sap, courser eyes, and a fey dragon scale to brew a deadly concoction for his night elf captives in Malaka'jin.

faq.q: What happens after Jin'Zil receives the whiskers?
faq.answer: After receiving the ingredients, Jin'Zil unleashes his brew in his cave. It swiftly kills the caged night elf prisoners, whose spirits emerge as wisps and drift away.

angles.text: As a troll, you see Jin'Zil use local beasts as reagents in Darkspear voodoo, turning the forest's natural essence against his enemies.
As a night elf, you see sacred woodland creatures like twilight runners and fey dragons desecrated to poison night elf captives in Kalimdor's forests.
